## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M15 - Retrieval Engine Self-Tuning.

## Technical Scope

- Python 3.9+ modular codebase with configuration-driven execution
- Three core modules: data_auto_gen, cross_enc_exp, auto_eval
- Supports integration into CI/CD or scheduled experiment pipelines
- Evaluation and optimization depend on endpoint quality, model selection, and hardware resources
- Designed for controlled experimentation before large-scale deployment

## Run Guidance

Run module scripts and pipelines from repository entry points with external endpoint configuration

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
